reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Peek again
reauth_confirm.description: Peek needs you to sign in again: the connection expired or was removed, or it isn’t allowed to see, add or edit parcels yet.

abort.reauth_successful: You’re signed in to Peek again.

create_entry.default:
You’re signed in to Peek.

To add the Peek parcels card to a dashboard, first reload this page (in the Home Assistant app, close it and open it again): the card loads when a page opens. Then edit the dashboard, select **Add card**, open **By card** and search for “Peek”.

state.customs_duties: Import duties or taxes to pay
state.not_announced: Still waiting for the carrier’s first update
state.stalled: No tracking update for four days

not_loaded.message: Peek isn’t set up, or isn’t loaded.

auth_failed.message: Peek refused the sign-in. Sign in to Peek again.

missing_scope.message: This connection may not do this. Sign in to Peek again and allow it to see and add parcels.

missing_edit_scope.message: Home Assistant may not edit your parcels in Peek yet. Sign in to Peek again once to allow it: select Reconfigure next to Peek in Settings › Devices & services.

rate_limited.message: Too many requests to Peek. Try again in a minute.

update_failed.message: Couldn’t read the parcels from Peek: {error}

carrier_not_found.message: Peek has no carrier with the id {carrier}.

url_changed.message: Peek’s address is now {url}. Sign in to Peek there.

add_parcels.name: Add parcels
add_parcels.description: Finds the tracking numbers in a text, such as the shipping part of an order email, and adds each to Peek. A number Peek already follows is left as it is.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text holding one or more tracking numbers. Send only the shipping part: Peek keeps the numbers and the name, nothing else.

name.name: Name
name.description: What to call the parcel, usually the shop it comes from.

archive_parcel.name: Archive a parcel
archive_parcel.description: Moves a parcel to the archive, out of the list of deliveries. You can restore it with Restore a parcel, or in Peek.

parcel.name: Parcel
parcel.description: The parcel’s id or tracking number.

restore_parcel.name: Restore a parcel
restore_parcel.description: Brings an archived parcel back to the list of deliveries.

parcel.name: Parcel
parcel.description: The parcel’s id or tracking number.

rename_parcel.name: Rename a parcel
rename_parcel.description: Gives a parcel the name Peek lists it by, such as what it holds or the shop it comes from.

parcel.name: Parcel
parcel.description: The parcel’s id or tracking number.

name.name: Name
name.description: The new name, at most 80 characters. Empty clears it.

change_carrier.name: Change a parcel’s carrier
change_carrier.description: Sets the carrier that delivers a parcel, when Peek has the wrong one, and checks the parcel with it at once.

parcel.name: Parcel
parcel.description: The parcel’s id or tracking number.

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.description: Peek’s id for the carrier, such as dhl, ups, la-poste or dpd-de.

postcode.name: Postcode
postcode.description: The delivery postcode, for a carrier that asks for it. Without one, the parcel keeps the postcode it has; empty removes it.

set_parcel_notifications.name: Turn a parcel’s notifications on or off
set_parcel_notifications.description: Stops or resumes Peek’s notifications about a parcel. Peek’s emails about it stay as they are.

parcel.name: Parcel
parcel.description: The parcel’s id or tracking number.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: On for Peek’s notifications about this parcel, off for none.

get_parcels.name: Get parcels
get_parcels.description: Reads the parcels that match from Peek.

status.name: Status
status.description: Which parcels; on the way unless given.

sort.name: Order
sort.description: The order; each status has its own unless given.

search.name: Search
search.description: Words in the parcel’s name, shop, carrier, tracking number or scans.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: How many at most; 20 unless given.
